Mcp.Protocol.description: MCP protocol negotiation. "legacy" (default) opens with the initialize handshake and speaks protocol revisions up to 2025-11-25. "auto" probes for the 2026-07-28 revision and falls back to legacy when the server does not support it. "2026-07-28" requires that revision and fails otherwise.

start.description: Startup script to run when creating a new workspace (worktree)

run.description: Shell command to run in the Session's directory. Alone, exit 0 wakes and stdout is appended.

code.description: Code Mode JavaScript check (no fetch; 30s, 20 tool calls, 32 KB output cap). Call tools statically as tools.<ns>.<tool>(...) or tools["ns-name"].tool(...); each is authorized once at creation to run unattended. Runs once at creation with state = null (if baselines state without waking; until matches immediately if true), with globals state, now (epoch ms) and runs. Return a boolean or { wake, state?, message? } (message is appended to prompt on wake), e.g.: const t = await tools.slack.read_thread({ id }); return { wake: state !== null && t.count > state.count, state: { count: t.count }, message: "New reply" }

prompt.description: The message the Session receives when the schedule wakes.

Schedule.Duration.description: A duration such as "90 seconds", "5 minutes" or "2 hours".

interrupted.description: Whether an active execution owned by this OpenCode process was interrupted.

SessionsCursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned as cursor.previous or cursor.next in the previous response.

info.description: Experimental HttpApi surface for selected instance routes.
info.title: opencode HttpApi

get.description: Retrieve currently registered agents.
Retrieve a single currently registered agent.
Retrieve currently registered commands.
Return configuration documents and discovery sources for the requested location, from lowest to highest priority.
Return shells available to terminal and agent execution.
List every stored integration credential, including its secret value.

post.description: Store an integration credential. It becomes the integration's active credential unless activate is false and the integration already has one. Fails with a conflict when the requested ID already exists, and with an invalid request when an `integration.connect` policy denies the integration.
Activate a stored integration credential.

Write a JavaScript heap snapshot of the server process into its log directory, or the requested directory, and return the server-local path once the file is complete. Pauses the server while the heap serializes and can temporarily increase its memory use. The snapshot can contain credentials, prompts, and file contents.

schema.description: Absolute server-local directory to write the snapshot into, created when missing. Defaults to the server's log directory.

memory.description: The server process's memory in bytes, read just before the snapshot (Node's process.memoryUsage()). rss covers native memory the snapshot cannot show.

delete.description: Dispose the requested location's cached services so its next use boots them fresh.

get.description: List locations currently loaded by the server.
Subscribe to native events and plugin RPC events across all server locations. Volatile by contract: a slow consumer overflows and fails the stream, and events during disconnection are missed.

schema.description: Only send events of these types, plus the initial server.connected event. When omitted, all events are sent.

get.description: List published artifacts, newest update first. Experimental: needs experimental.artifacts in the Location's config and may change without notice.

post.description: Publish a new artifact through the selected or default artifact provider. Experimental: needs experimental.artifacts in the Location's config and may change without notice.

get.description: Return active artifact providers and default. Experimental: needs experimental.artifacts in the Location's config and may change without notice.

delete.description: Remove an artifact and its stored files. Experimental: needs experimental.artifacts in the Location's config and may change without notice.

get.description: Read an artifact's metadata and file contents. Experimental: needs experimental.artifacts in the Location's config and may change without notice.

patch.description: Replace an artifact's files at the same ID and URL. Experimental: needs experimental.artifacts in the Location's config and may change without notice.

get.description: Serve HTML and static files from the local provider. Experimental: needs experimental.artifacts in the Location's config and may change without notice.

Upgrade to a WebSocket over which the client hosts an MCP server named after `name`; its tools stay available while the socket is open. One JSON-RPC message per text frame. Experimental: may change without compatibility guarantees.

post.description: Create a short-lived single-use ticket for opening a client MCP WebSocket connection from a browser.

patch.description: Patch supported fields in the highest-precedence global configuration document.

delete.description: Stop watching one file relative to the requested location. Experimental: may change without compatibility guarantees.

path.description: A file path relative to the requested location.

post.description: Watch one file relative to the requested location for 24 hours, publishing filesystem.changed on that location when it changes. Watching an already watched file resets its expiry. Paths follow read confinement. Experimental: may change without compatibility guarantees.

path.description: A file path relative to the requested location.

post.description: Write the raw request body to an absolute path or a path relative to the requested location, creating parent directories, and return the resolved absolute path. Unlike read, the target is not confined to the location. Experimental: may change without compatibility guarantees.

schema.description: An absolute path or a path relative to the requested location. Missing parent directories are created.

post.description: Deprecated alias of POST /api/experimental/generate/text.
Ask a decision model typed predicate, choice and score questions about the input and return one probability-bearing answer per question, in question order. Stateless: nothing is stored.
Generate or edit images with an image model using the server's base configuration and return them as base64. Stateless: nothing is stored.
Run one stateless model generation using the server's base configuration and return the assistant text. Uses the base configuration's default model when none is specified.
Discover and persist an experimental wellknown integration source.

get.description: List active and unconsumed background jobs, optionally filtered by owning session, descendants, or kind. Experimental: may change without compatibility guarantees.

schema.description: Filter to background jobs owned by this session.
Filter by background job kind (shell, subagent, or image).
Filter by job status (running, completed, error, or cancelled).

Return the progress of the V1 to V2 session history migration.

get.description: Stream persistent PTY output through the OpenCode server.
List a Session's schedules, oldest first. Experimental: needs experimental.schedules in the Session's config and may change without notice.

post.description: Schedule a prompt that wakes the Session once after a delay, at a time, every interval, or on a cron. Experimental: needs experimental.schedules in the Session's config and may change without notice.

get.description: Read one schedule. Experimental: needs experimental.schedules in the Session's config and may change without notice.

post.description: Stop a schedule from firing until it is resumed. Experimental: needs experimental.schedules in the Session's config and may change without notice.

Resume a paused schedule. A one-shot that fell due while paused fires once; a repeating schedule resumes at its next slot. Experimental: needs experimental.schedules in the Session's config and may change without notice.

Import a projected session transcript at the requested location. Accepts transcripts exported by earlier releases. If parentID is supplied, the parent session must already exist; import parents before children.

get.description: Aggregate local session activity, usage, and tool reliability for a time range.
Export a complete projected session transcript.
List API-managed instruction entries attached to the session.

put.description: Attach or replace one durable instruction entry. Changes announce as updates at the next step boundary.

get.description: Experimental durable session event log. Reads events after an exclusive aggregate sequence and continues with live events when follow=true.

post.description: Activate a skill for a session by appending a skill message and resuming execution.

get.description: Read the last physical rows without changing selection or taking control. Omitted lines uses the live terminal height; larger counts include retained history. Blank rows are preserved. Screen dimensions and cursor remain relative to the live screen. Returns null when no current terminal exists. Selection is server-local and resets on restart. Experimental: may change without compatibility guarantees.

Return the server identity, connection URLs, paths, and readiness status.

post.description: Check one or all package plugins for available updates.

Execute a slash command callback immediately.
Durably admit a session compaction request. Steers by default: it runs at the next step boundary instead of waiting behind queued prompts.

get.description: Retrieve the active context messages for a session (all messages after the last compaction).

Structured per-file diffs of the files a turn changed. A turn runs from the first prompt after the session was last idle until its next idle marker, so prompts steered in while it was busy belong to the same turn; `to` extends the range through a later turn. Compares the range's first recorded snapshot with its last; a step still running in the active session compares against the working copy. Ranges that span a location change are rejected. In sessions without any idle marker, a prompt's turn spans until the next user message.

schema.description: User message whose turn to diff. Defaults to the turn of the newest user message.
Later user message whose turn ends the range. Defaults to the turn of `from` alone.
Unchanged lines around each hunk. Omit for full-file patches.

post.description: Create a child session by copying projected history before a message. Omit before to copy the full history.

post.description: Interrupt active execution owned by this OpenCode process. Returns interrupted=true when an active execution was interrupted and false for the idle no-op. When resume=true, execution resumes pending steering input and next-in-line control items (manual compaction, moves) while queued prompts remain parked.

schema.description: Maximum number of messages to return. When omitted, the endpoint returns its default page size.
Message order for the first page. Use desc for newest first or asc for oldest first.

get.description: Retrieve a pending permission request owned by a session.

Stage or move a reversible session boundary and optionally apply its file changes.

Durably admit synthetic session input and schedule execution unless resume is false.
Mark the idle transition observed by the viewer as viewed.

get.description: List currently running shell commands for a location. Exited commands are not included.

post.description: Spawn one non-interactive shell command for a location. Combined stdout/stderr is captured to a file pageable via output.

Page through captured combined output by absolute byte cursor.
Retrieve currently registered skills.
Get current and default branch information for the requested location.

Infer a local review base from named branch creation history, or the repository default only when currently on that branch. Returns null before the first commit or when the provider lacks base metadata; ambiguous Git history requires an explicit base on diff requests.
List local and remote branches available at the requested location.

Diff HEAD to the working copy (working), the base merge-base to the working copy (branch), or the base merge-base to HEAD (committed). Omitting base preserves repository-default comparison; supplying it overrides the comparison without saving it.

post.description: Initialize a repository using the selected VCS provider in a markerless project's directory and refresh its location services. Omitting provider defaults to git; built-in git and hg providers support initialization. An unknown provider returns 400; a registered provider without init returns 501.

get.description: List uncommitted working-copy changes relative to the requested location.

post.description: Run one web search through the selected provider. Specify a provider to override the configured default.

get.description: Return the registered web search providers.

delete.description: Load the project's canonical configuration and remove a saved worktree using its recorded strategy.

get.description: Return the project's saved worktree inventory without loading configuration or running discovery.

post.description: Load the project's canonical configuration, create a local worktree using its selected strategy, then run the project's setup script.
Load the project's canonical configuration, discover worktrees across known checkout roots using all available strategies, and reconcile saved state.

get.description: Redeem a pairing code. Browsers receive a session cookie and a redirect to the web app; requests that accept JSON receive a session token to use as the password.
